description: By Lauri Shillings, Indiana Secretary of State Candidate (L – Carmel) Today, the voices of Hoosier voters prevailed over big government interference from D.C. I am incredibly proud of the 31 Indiana State Senators who rejected Trump’s plea to gerrymander our state’s congressional districts.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lauri for Liberty
title: Indiana Drew a Line, and It Wasn’t on a Map. — Lauri Shillings for Indiana Secretary of State
